====================================================================================================
YOUPEAK ANDROID APP — COMPLETE IMAGE / ICON / EMOJI GENERATION PROMPT BOOK (for ChatGPT image generation)
====================================================================================================
Prepared: 2026-09-24
Scope: every image asset in the Flutter app (youpeak/lib + youpeak/assets/icons + android/app/src/main/res),
       every screen, every bottom sheet, every dialog, plus a NEW custom emoji / reaction / badge system
       designed so the app looks like a world-class, top-10-on-Play-Store product.

HOW THIS FILE IS ORGANISED
  PART 0  — What I found in the app (audit) — READ FIRST, it changes how you generate
  PART 1  — Workflow: how to use these prompts in ChatGPT to get consistent, professional results
  PART 2  — The YouPeak Visual DNA (brand colours, grid, materials) — the "style lock" blocks
  PART 3  — Brand & system assets (launcher icon, adaptive icon, splash, notification icon, shortcuts)
  PART 4  — Navigation & app-bar glyph icons (tintable, outline + solid pairs)
  PART 5  — Video player, Bites (shorts) & engagement glyph icons
  PART 6  — Create / camera / upload / live glyph icons
  PART 7  — Account, profile menu, settings & utility glyph icons
  PART 8  — Arrows, status & form glyph icons
  PART 9  — Premium 3D icons (coins, gifts, crown, lock, rewards, wallet...)
  PART 10 — Tier emblems & badges (VIP Passes, Tasker levels, verified, LIVE, premium) — NEW
  PART 11 — YouPeak Reaction Emoji Pack (comments, live chat, reactions) — NEW
  PART 12 — YouPeak Celebration & System Stickers (rewards, streaks, dialogs, notifications) — NEW
  PART 13 — Spot illustrations (onboarding, login, empty states, success dialogs, feature heroes)
  PART 14 — Store & marketing graphics (Play Store feature graphic, screenshots frame backgrounds)
  PART 15 — Third-party logos (Google, Apple, social, payment gateways) — DO NOT GENERATE, instructions inside
  PART 16 — Master checklist (every file, its prompt ID, its status)

Every prompt block looks like this:
  [ID] file name
  File path / Status (REPLACE existing file or NEW file) / Style family / Where it appears / Render size / Export spec
  PROMPT >>>  ...copy everything between the >>> and <<< markers into ChatGPT...  <<<

Each prompt is SELF-CONTAINED (the full style lock is embedded inside it), so you can paste any single
prompt into a fresh chat and still get an on-brand result. The long repeated style paragraphs are
deliberate: identical wording = identical look across 250+ assets.

PART 0 — AUDIT: WHAT I FOUND IN THE CURRENT APP (read before generating)
====================================================================================================

0.1  BRAND COLOURS IN CODE (lib/utils/colors/app_color.dart — "YouPeak UI/UX Spec v3.0")
     Primary Accent  Forest Green ........ #0A7A44
     Dark Forest Accent .................. #1E4D2B
     Secondary / Pill BG  Mint Green ..... #E8F5E9
     Gold VIP Accent ..................... #FFD700
     Screen Background ................... #FFFFFF   (dark mode: #1C1C1E charcoal, cards #1E4D2B)
     Primary Text & Icons  Dark Charcoal . #1C1C1E
     Notification Accent  Crimson Red .... #D32F2F
     Search Container BG ................. #F0F4F1
     Orange (warnings/coins text) ........ #FF981F / #F99300, light #FFF2D4
     Brand gradient ...................... #1E4D2B -> #0A7A44 (left to right)
     Font: Urbanist (Google Fonts) — geometric, rounded terminals. Icons must feel like they belong to Urbanist:
           soft geometric, rounded ends, friendly but precise.

0.2  THE BIG VISUAL PROBLEM: the art does not match the brand.
     The code was re-branded to Forest Green + Gold, but many images are leftovers from the original
     template and are still PINK / CORAL RED (#FF4D67-style):
       - boarding_1.png, boarding_2.png, boarding_3.png  (flat "unDraw" pink women with play buttons)
       - premium_image.png  (pink gradient crown on the "Join Premium" card)
       - most success / empty / monetization / wallet / referral illustrations
     The launcher logo (app_logo.png) is a dark-navy squircle with an orange->green ring and a small
     orange dot on top — close, but not using the brand greens.
     => Regenerating everything in ONE consistent green+gold system is the single biggest upgrade
        you can make to how "premium" the app feels.

0.3  HOW THE APP DRAWS ICONS — THIS DECIDES THE STYLE OF EACH PROMPT
     (a) TINTED GLYPHS. ~120 icons are drawn with Flutter ImageIcon(...) or Image.asset(color: ...).
         Flutter throws away their colours and repaints only the SHAPE (alpha channel) in one colour
         (black in light mode, white in dark mode, green when selected, white over videos).
         => These MUST be single-colour black shapes on a transparent background. No gradients, no
            shadows, no grey, no second colour. Anything semi-transparent turns into a muddy smear.
         => Prompts in PARTS 4–8 are written for this. Family name: "GLYPH".
     (b) FULL-COLOUR ICONS. Coins, gifts, crown, lock, reward icons, ad icons, success images are drawn
         as-is (no tint). => These get the premium 3D treatment (PART 9), family "3D PEAK".
     (c) ILLUSTRATIONS. Onboarding, login, empty states, dialogs, feature heroes (PART 13), family "SOFT CLAY".
     (d) DUAL-USE WARNING: king.png, timeCircle (TimeCircle.png), done.png and app_logo_icon.png are
         drawn BOTH tinted and full-colour in different screens. Their prompts are written so the
         silhouette alone still reads correctly when tinted (solid outer shape, no floating shadow).

0.4  BOTTOM NAVIGATION (main_home_view.dart) — 5 slots:
       Home (home.png / boldHome.png) | Bites (Video.png / boldVideo.png) | [ + CREATE ] |
       Subscription (videoCircle.png / boldPlay.png) | Library (library.png / boldDocument.png)
     Outline = inactive, Solid = active. The two must share the same silhouette.
     Create sheet: "Create a Bite" (boldVideo.png), "Upload a Video" (upload.png), "Go Live" (boldPlay.png)
     -> boldPlay.png is currently used for BOTH "Subscription active" and "Go Live". I added a NEW
        dedicated go_live.png prompt; swap the Go Live tile to it in main_home_view.dart line ~283.

0.5  OTHER THINGS FOUND
     - Notification small icon uses @mipmap/ic_launcher -> Android shows it as a WHITE SQUARE in the
       status bar. A proper monochrome notification icon prompt is included (PART 3, [A-06]).
     - app_logo.png, appLogo.png, app_logo_icon.png, splash_logo.png are the SAME file 4 times (22 KB).
       They have different jobs; separate prompts are provided.
     - splash_image.png is 3.2 MB, cardImage.png 944 KB, Internet.jpg 685 KB, Check.jpg 532 KB —
       far too heavy. Export new versions as optimised PNG/WebP (targets given per prompt).
     - AppIcons declares 5 files that do not exist (card.png, liveChat.png, blueTik.png, colorFilter.png,
       ArrowDown1.png). They are not referenced anywhere, so no crash — but blueTik (verified tick) and
       liveChat are good ideas; prompts for both are included as NEW assets.
     - Twitter is now "X" — the twitter.png glyph should be the X logo (see PART 15).
     - mic.json and like.json are Lottie animations — ChatGPT cannot make Lottie files. Guidance in PART 15.
     - There are NO emojis in the UI today (only in debug logs and share text). PARTS 11 & 12 give you a
       full custom emoji / sticker system for comments, live chat, rewards, streaks and notifications.

====================================================================================================
PART 1 — WORKFLOW: HOW TO GET WORLD-CLASS, CONSISTENT RESULTS FROM CHATGPT
====================================================================================================

1.1  ONE CHAT PER FAMILY. Open a new ChatGPT chat for each style family (Glyph, 3D Peak, Soft Clay, Emoji,
     Badges). Keep generating that family in the same chat, so the model "remembers" the look. When a result
     is perfect, say: "Lock this exact style. Every next icon must match this one in stroke, corner radius,
     proportions, lighting and colour." Then continue.

1.2  TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND. Every prompt already asks for a real transparent PNG. If ChatGPT returns a
     white or checkerboard background anyway, reply exactly:
       "Regenerate the exact same image with a truly transparent background (alpha channel), not white,
        not a drawn checkerboard."
     Still wrong? Remove the background with remove.bg / Photoshop "Remove Background" / Figma plugin.

1.3  CANVAS SIZES ChatGPT supports: 1024x1024 (square), 1536x1024 (landscape), 1024x1536 (portrait).
     Generate at those, then resize to the export size given in each prompt (Photoshop, Figma, or
     squoosh.app). Never upscale a small image — always downscale from the 1024 master.

1.4  GLYPH ICONS (PARTS 4–8) — CRITICAL PRO TIP. AI image models are good at icon DESIGN but their lines
     are never perfectly crisp or perfectly consistent in stroke width. For a truly pro finish:
       a) Generate the glyph with the prompt.
       b) Vectorise it: vectorizer.ai, Adobe Illustrator Image Trace, or Figma + "Image Tracer" plugin.
       c) In Figma/Illustrator, snap to the 24x24 grid and set every stroke to exactly 1.75 px (outline)
          — solid icons are filled shapes.
       d) Export PNG at 96x96 (and keep the SVG master for the future).
     If you skip vectorising, still export at 96x96 or 128x128 — downscaling hides small wobbles.
     BATCH TIP: you can also ask for a "4x4 icon sheet" by pasting the Glyph style block once and listing
     16 icon subjects; then crop. Sheets give MORE consistent stroke weights than one-by-one generation.

1.5  FILE NAMES. Save each result with the EXACT file name shown in the prompt and drop it into
     youpeak/assets/icons/ (overwrite). Same name = zero code changes. NEW assets need a one-line
     AppIcons constant (lib/utils/icons/app_icons.dart) and a widget that uses them.

1.6  QUALITY GATE — check every image before accepting it:
       [ ] On-palette only (no pink, purple, blue unless the prompt allows it)
       [ ] Transparent background, no white fringe (test it on #1C1C1E dark AND on #FFFFFF)
       [ ] No accidental text, letters, watermark or signature
       [ ] Centred with even padding; same visual size as its siblings
       [ ] Glyphs: pure black, one stroke weight, rounded caps, readable at 20 px
       [ ] 3D: light from top-left, same gloss level, no floor shadow
       [ ] Filled/outline pair: identical silhouette and size

1.7  COMMON FIX-UP REPLIES YOU CAN PASTE
       "Make the stroke thinner and perfectly uniform, 1.75 units on a 24-unit grid, round caps."
       "Too detailed — simplify to the minimum shapes needed to read at 20 pixels."
       "Remove the drop shadow and the floor; keep only the object on transparency."
       "Use only the brand palette: #0A7A44, #1E4D2B, #E8F5E9, #FFD700, #1C1C1E. Remove the other colours."
       "Center it optically and scale it so it fills 80% of the canvas."
       "Same image, but no text or letters anywhere."

====================================================================================================
PART 2 — THE YOUPEAK VISUAL DNA (read once; it is already embedded inside every prompt)
====================================================================================================

2.1  PALETTE (use nothing else)
     Forest Green  #0A7A44  hero brand colour, active states, primary buttons
     Dark Forest   #1E4D2B  depth, dark cards, gradients' dark end
     Emerald       #19A463  highlights, lighter gradient end
     Mint          #E8F5E9  light surfaces, pills;  Mint Light #CFF5DD  rim light (the family signature)
     VIP Gold      #FFD700  premium, coins, crowns;  Deep Gold #E0A800;  Gold Highlight #FFF1A8
     Charcoal      #1C1C1E  text, dark-mode background
     Crimson       #D32F2F  LIVE, errors, destructive only
     Amber         #FF981F  warnings, flame accents

2.2  THE YOUPEAK MARK (the brand's visual hook, re-used on coins, emblems, placeholders, cards)
     A rounded play triangle whose upper edge carries a double mountain-peak notch (right summit taller),
     plus a small gold sun circle above the tallest summit. Reads "play" first, "peak" second.

2.3  THE SEVEN STYLE FAMILIES
     GLYPH (outline + solid) ... every tintable UI icon. Pure black on transparent, 24-unit grid, 1.75 stroke,
                                 2.5 corner radius, round caps. Outline = inactive, Solid = active.
     3D PEAK ................... full-colour objects: coins, gifts, crown, lock, rewards, notification stickers.
                                 Satin gloss, top-left key light, MINT RIM LIGHT on the right edge, no floor shadow.
     FLAT BRAND ................ small full-colour UI parts (send button, record button, edit badge).
     YOUPEAK EMBLEMS ........... tier badges: the "peak shield" with metal rim + enamel face; metal = rank.
     REACTION EMOJI ............ custom 3D emoji: golden face + mint rim light; exclusive green heart, peak, coin-eyes.
     SOFT CLAY ................. every illustration: matte clay, rounded, green + mint + a touch of gold.
     BRAND ..................... launcher icon, adaptive layers, splash, store graphics.

2.4  GLYPH BATCH-SHEET PROMPT (optional — best consistency for glyphs)
     Paste this, then list up to 16 subjects (copy the SUBJECT lines from PARTS 4–8):
     >>>
     Create a 4 x 4 grid icon sheet on a transparent background, each icon in its own equal square cell with
     generous spacing, no cell borders, no labels. All 16 icons must be drawn in exactly the same style:
     STYLE VARIANT: OUTLINE (regular / inactive state). Everything is drawn with ONE uniform stroke of exactly 1.75 units (about 7.3% of the icon width), round line caps, round line joins, no variable thickness, no filled areas except tiny dots (dots are solid circles 2.25 units in diameter). This icon belongs to "YouPeak Glyph", the custom UI icon family of YouPeak — a premium Indian video-streaming, short-video ("Bites"), live-streaming and creator-earnings app whose typeface is Urbanist (geometric, rounded, friendly). The family must reach the finish of Apple SF Symbols, Google Material Symbols Rounded, Phosphor and Iconsax, while being its own recognisable set. GEOMETRY: draw on a strict 24 x 24 unit grid scaled up to the canvas, with a 2-unit safe margin on all four sides so the live area is 20 x 20 units. Standard keyline shapes: circle 20 units in diameter, square 18 x 18, portrait rectangle 16 x 20, landscape rectangle 20 x 16 — shapes of different types must look optically equal in size (circles slightly larger than squares, triangles nudged right so they look centred). Corner radius: 2.5 units on outer corners of every rectangle / squircle, 1 unit on inner corners; no sharp 90-degree corners anywhere except where a crisp point is part of the meaning (arrow tips still have a 0.5-unit micro-rounding). COLOUR AND RENDERING: pure solid black #000000 at 100% opacity only, on a completely TRANSPARENT background with a real alpha channel — not white, not grey, not a checkerboard drawn into the pixels. The app re-colours this icon at runtime using only its alpha shape (Flutter ImageIcon), so there must be NO gradients, NO shading, NO shadows, NO glow, NO 3D, NO texture, NO outline around the outline, NO semi-transparent parts and NO second colour — only crisp, anti-aliased solid black shapes. Keep counters and gaps at least 1.5 units wide so the icon stays readable at 18–24 pixels on a phone and never clogs when tinted white over a video. Minimal, confident, no decorative extras. No text, letters or numbers unless the subject explicitly asks for them, no watermark, no signature, no frame, no background plate, no mock-up, no phone, no hand, no drop shadow.
     The 16 subjects, in reading order, are: 1) ... 2) ... (paste subjects here)
     <<<
     Then crop each cell, vectorise, and export as described in 1.4.

[A-01]  appLogo.png
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
File path ....... youpeak/assets/icons/appLogo.png
Status .......... REPLACE existing file (same name = no code change)
Style family .... BRAND
Where it appears  Master source for flutter_launcher_icons (pubspec.yaml image_path) -> generates every Android mipmap + iOS icon. Also the Play Store 512x512 icon.
Rendered size ... Launcher: 48dp on home screen; Play Store: 512 px
Export .......... 1024x1024 PNG, NO transparency (fully opaque, full-bleed square — Android and iOS apply their own rounded mask). Also save a 512x512 copy for Play Console.

PROMPT >>>
Brand identity work for YouPeak — a premium Indian video-streaming, short-video ("Bites"), live-streaming and creator-earnings app. The name means "You at your peak". Brand colours: Forest Green #0A7A44, Dark Forest #1E4D2B, Emerald highlight #19A463, Mint #E8F5E9, VIP Gold #FFD700 / #E0A800, Charcoal #1C1C1E, White. Typeface: Urbanist (geometric, rounded). Quality bar: the app icons of YouTube, Spotify, Netflix, Duolingo, Cred and Revolut — bold, simple, instantly recognisable at 48 pixels, timeless rather than trendy, no clutter, no tiny details, no text inside the icon. THE YOUPEAK MARK (use consistently everywhere): a rounded play triangle (pointing right, corners rounded to 12% of its height) whose top edge is interrupted by a crisp mountain-peak notch — so the upper-left part of the triangle forms two mountain summits — and a small solid gold circle (#FFD700) sitting just above and right of the highest summit like a rising sun / "you at the top". The mark must read as "play" first and "peak" second.

SUBJECT: the official YouPeak app launcher icon, full-bleed square version. Fill the ENTIRE 1024 x 1024 square edge to edge with the background (no rounded corners, no transparent corners, no border, no inner squircle — the operating system cuts the shape). BACKGROUND: a rich diagonal gradient from Dark Forest #1E4D2B at the top-left corner to Forest Green #0A7A44 at the centre to Emerald #19A463 at the bottom-right corner, with a very soft radial lift of light (+8% brightness) behind the mark so it glows gently, and an ultra-subtle diagonal sheen. FOREGROUND: the YouPeak mark, centred optically (nudged 3% to the right because it is a triangle), sized so the whole mark fits inside the central 60% of the canvas (the Android adaptive safe zone): a bold white (#FFFFFF) rounded play triangle; its upper edge is interrupted by a crisp double mountain-peak notch so the upper-left portion of the triangle forms two summits — the right summit taller — like a mountain range cut into the play button; a solid VIP Gold (#FFD700 with a gentle #E0A800 lower edge) circle, diameter about 16% of the triangle height, floats just above and to the right of the tallest summit like a rising sun. Give the white triangle an extremely soft, short, dark-forest inner-side shadow (#0B3B20 at 25%) at its bottom-right edge for depth, and a faint top highlight — it must still read as a flat, confident, modern mark, not a heavy 3D object. No text, no letters, no words, no extra sparkles, no border. It must be recognisable and striking at 48 pixels next to YouTube, Instagram and Netflix on a phone home screen.
<<< END PROMPT

No watermark. OUTPUT: 1024 x 1024 PNG, transparent background.

SUBJECT: CREATOR tier emblem, level 1 — "Classic Pass" (free starting tier). Rim: satin brushed pewter / soft steel (#C9D1CC highlights, #8C9690 shadows). Enamel face: matte Mint (#E8F5E9) enamel. ====================================================================================================
PART 15 — THIRD-PARTY LOGOS & ANIMATIONS — DO NOT GENERATE THESE WITH AI
====================================================================================================

Brand logos are trademarks with strict usage rules; an AI-drawn "almost Google G" looks cheap and can get the
app flagged in Play review. Always download the official files:

  google_logo.png ........ Google "G" — developers.google.com/identity/branding-guidelines (sign-in button kit)
  apple_logo.png ......... Apple logo — developer.apple.com/design/resources ("Sign in with Apple" kit). Tinted in
                           code, so use the solid black glyph.
  facebook.png / facebookLogo.png, instagram.png, whatsApp.png ... official brand resource centres
                           (meta.com/brand/resources). facebook/instagram are TINTED in the channel About tab,
                           so export the one-colour glyph version, black on transparent, 96x96.
  twitter.png ............ Twitter is now X — use the official X logo (about.x.com/en/who-we-are/brand-toolkit),
                           black on transparent. Also rename the label in the UI from Twitter to X.
  Payment gateways: razorPay.png, stripe.png, paypal.png + ic_paypal_logo.webp, flutter_wave_icon.png +
                           flutter_wave_logo.png, paystack_image.png, cash_free_icon.webp — download from each
                           company's official brand / press kit (Razorpay brand assets, Stripe press kit,
                           PayPal brand guidelines, Flutterwave, Paystack, Cashfree). Export 192x192 icons
                           and 600px-wide logos on transparent backgrounds.
  Simple Icons (simpleicons.org) is a good free source of consistent monochrome brand glyphs (check each
  brand's own licence).

Consistent CONTAINER for these logos (optional, makes the payment and login rows look premium): this is
UI work, not image generation — put each official logo inside a 48x48 dp rounded-square (radius 14) with
Mint #E8F5E9 background in light mode and #26332B in dark mode.

LOTTIE ANIMATIONS (mic.json on the Search voice button, like.json): ChatGPT cannot make Lottie files. Get free
animations from lottiefiles.com (search "microphone listening", "heart like burst"), then recolour them to
#0A7A44 / #FFD700 with the LottieFiles online editor ("Edit colours") so they match the palette.
